label: ESTIMATE
method: Residual = team result minus the frozen B1 Elo pre-game win probability (home court unless neutral). Effect = mean residual with the condition minus without, on the win-probability scale; log-odds effect by the delta method. Absence: games of the team between the player's first and last appearance for it in a season, absent = no play-by-play event for him; seasons pooled per player-team; bootstrap resamples absent and present games separately (B=2000). Schedule: bootstrap resamples whole games (B=2000).
assumptions_and_flags: absences mix rest, injury, suspension, illness and coach decisions; the data cannot tell them apart
small_n: fewer than 5 games missed; intervals are wide and unstable
team_change_in_window: the player appeared for more than one team in a season
Elo partly absorbs long absences (ratings drift while a player is out), shrinking estimates toward 0
end-of-tenure absences (after the last appearance) are not counted

low_involvement_outcome_dependent_appearance: median play-by-play events per game below 8; such players often appear only when a game is decided (garbage time), so appearance depends on the outcome and the estimate is biased
no multiplicity adjustment: about 5% of intervals exclude 0 by chance alone across this many keys
2025-26 neutral-site games are not flagged (home court applied)
